name: ERTH 1055
title: Geoscience and the American Landscape
description: An Honors Core course. Foundation course in geology linked to the American Landscape through readings from American history and literature. Students who complete both ERTH 1055 and ERTH 1052 may request that ERTH 1055 be converted to a CA 3 Laboratory course. CA 3.
requirement_description: Open only to Honors students. Not open for credit to students who have passed ERTH 1010, 1050, 1051, 1070.
